newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. debt futures inch lower in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. debt futures inch lower in late trade.

text.p: April 14 - Most U.S. debt futures inched lower in light, late trade. June T-bonds tested the lower end of the day's range at 106-18/32. One firm was a heavy seller of June Euros at 93.97, while Sept Euros crept lower to 93.64. Open interest for total bond futures rose 18,730 on Friday.
